article.title: Would Idaho have more people if it were a separate country?
article.excerpt: Call me silly but I think about questions like this. It's a big state with only about 1.5 million people , even though it is the only place with six pointed star garnets (refined here ). Much of the state is beautiful. Imagine the counterfactual that, in 1846, when the U.S. and Great Britain resolved the border, one part of the area went its own way. Toda
